description.value: Patra Pizza & Curry House is a casual restaurant in Gibsons on the Sunshine Coast serving an eclectic menu that blends classic Canadian-style pizza with Indian-inspired dishes like butter chicken, curry poutine, and samosas, alongside burgers, wraps, and pasta. The breadth of offerings — including a notably wide range of vegetarian options — makes it a practical refuelling stop for mixed groups of touring cyclists. Online ordering with a pickup option allows riders to pre-order before rolling in.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at patrapizzacurryhouse.ca is active with a live online ordering system (copyright 2026), confirming the business is open. The website address (900 Gibsons Way #13, Gibsons, BC V0N1V6) is consistent with OSM data (addr:housenumber 900, addr:unit 13, addr:city Gibsons), and the website provides a phone number (+1 604 886-7675) that is absent from OSM tags. The menu and ordering interface confirm pickup/takeout and extensive vegetarian options, but no website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM addr:street contains multiple semicolon-separated values ('Gibsons Way;Hwy 101;Sunshine Coast Highway'), which is non-standard OSM tagging; website confirms the clean address as 900 Gibsons Way #13.
Phone number +1 604 886-7675 appears on the website but is absent from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website and online ordering system; a useful food stop for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.
